blocks.text: Specifications: Processor: 10th Gen Intel Core i7-10610U, 1.8 GHz up to 4.9 GHz, 4 Cores, 8 ThreadsOperating System: Windows 11 ProfessionalDisplay: 12.3-inch FHD (1920x1080) Touch ScreenRAM: 16GB DDR4 RAMHard Disk: 512GB Solid State DriveWireless: Bluetooth, WiFiPorts: 1 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A port with PowerShare; 2 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C ports with Thunderbolt3/PowerDelivery/DisplayPort; 1 Combo Mic/Headphone Jack

items: 【Intel Core i7 Processor 】The Dell Latitude 7210 2-in-1 laptop is powered by an Intel Core i7-10610U processor. It offering a base speed of 1.8 GHz and a maximum turbo frequency of 4.9 GHz. It provides solid performance for everyday computing tasks, multitasking, and light to moderate productivity workloads.

【High Speed RAM And Enormous Space】16GB DDR4 RAM makes it possible to run multiple applications and handle complex tasks at the same time; 512GB Solid State Drive with powerful storage for fast startup, secure data transfer and generous storage space for multimedia content.
【Full HD Display】This Dell laptop Latitude 7210 2-in-1 notebook comes with a 12.3" Touch Screen with FHD (1920x1280) resolution for stunningly clear visuals.

【Convertible Design】As a 2-in-1 device, the Dell Latitude 7210 can be used in multiple modes, including laptop, tablet, tent, and stand mode. This versatility allows users to adapt the device to their preferred usage scenario, whether they're typing documents, making presentations, taking notes, or consuming media.

【Operating System】Windows 11 Pro - Multi language supports English/Spanish/French. Enhanced security, remote management, and virtualization capabilities for more complex and demanding work environments.
